title: On a phone the List sort choice stays after a reload
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 phone or narrow browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011) on a phone, or a desktop browser narrowed to about 390 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Starting value: the sort is not Customer A-Z (set Newest First before you start).
  • Needs no test data of its own.

Setup

  1. At 390 px open Work Orders > tap the sort button (two arrows, "Sort work orders" next to the search) > Newest First.
  2. Check the setup worked: the sort list shows a tick next to Newest First.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Tap the sort button (two arrows, "Sort work orders").
  3. Pick Customer A-Z.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Read the sort button (tap it: the tick is on the chosen sort) and the order of the cards.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After the reload the sort still reads Customer A-Z and the cards are in customer name order A to Z.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§1 Business Case). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §2: “keeps its choice after a reload.”
  • PRD §1 Business Case: “List remains the default and stays exactly as it is in production today; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the switcher that offers the two new displays.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
